║  Introduction :                                                                                      ║
║  ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾                                                                                      ║
║  Greetings Witnesses.                                                                                ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Welcome to the account of a school that didn’t fall apart from chaos or catastrophe, but from    ║
║     something far simpler: a leader who never should have been in charge.                            ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     This isn’t a tale of guidance or mentorship it’s the story of a principal who treated his        ║
║     students like inconveniences, snapping at them for daring to ask for help.                       ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     At the center of this failing institution stands a man known only as “Mr.Mcgill,” a figure       ║
║     whose phone held things no educator should ever have on school grounds, and whose patience       ║
║     mysteriously appeared only when certain girls walked into the room.                              ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Surrounding him is a staff too tired to fight back and students who learned quickly that         ║
║     respect was a one‑way street. Boys were ignored, struggling kids were brushed aside, and         ║
║     anyone who wasn’t part of his chosen circle might as well have been invisible.                   ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     What bound this school together wasn’t leadership or care — it was the shared understanding      ║
║     that the person meant to protect them was the one failing them the most.                         ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     And through it all, Mr. Mcgill continued on, unbothered, unaccountable, and uninterested in      ║
║     anything that didn’t flatter his ego.                                                            ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Welcome to the downfall.                                                                         ║

║  Greetings, Witnesses.                                                                               ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Welcome to the chronicle of a downfall that didn’t require strategy, force, or even effort —     ║
║     only the quiet patience of two people watching someone unravel under the weight of his own       ║
║     bravado.                                                                                         ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     It began in a simple VRChat lobby, where Coco and Vyrq were passing time in peace. Then came     ║
║     “tjj121,” dragging along his ever‑silent companion “Mr_sharky999,” announcing himself with the   ║
║     confidence of someone who believed his reputation mattered more than his actions.                ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     The moment he entered, he tried to posture — asking, “Who am I doxxing?” as if the room would    ║
║     tremble. When he declared “Vyrq,” Coco responded not with fear, but with questions. Simple,      ║
║     technical questions — the kind anyone claiming expertise should answer without hesitation.       ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Yet silence followed.                                                                            ║
║     Not the silence of mystery — the silence of someone realizing the mask they wore had no          ║
║     structure beneath it.                                                                            ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     And when Vyrq casually mentioned calling his mother, the façade cracked completely. The ego      ║
║     that had carried him into the lobby collapsed just as quickly, leaving behind nothing but        ║
║     defensiveness and retreat.                                                                       ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     This is not a tale of conflict. It is the story of a persona meeting reality — and losing.       ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Welcome to the conquering of “tjj121.”                                                           ║

║  Introduction :                                                                                      ║
║  ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾                                                                                      ║
║  Greetings Witnesses.                                                                                ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Tonight’s chronicle follows a boy who didn’t climb through talent, discipline, or knowledge,     ║
║     but through the loud confidence of someone who mistakes Discord servers for certification.       ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     This is the tale of a VRChat regular who calls himself a “doxxer,” a “hunter,” and a “coder,”    ║
║     yet still types with two fingers and Googles every command he pretends to understand.            ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     At the center of this digital comedy stands a kid known as “Suppyss,” a self‑appointed menace    ║
║     whose entire persona is built from recycled threats, half‑learned buzzwords, and confidence he   ║
║     didn’t earn.                                                                                     ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     His world is stitched together from YouTube tutorials he didn’t finish, scripts he can’t read,   ║
║     and the belief that saying “I have your IP” makes him dangerous. In truth, Suppyss couldn’t      ║
║     troubleshoot a Wi‑Fi issue without calling in a sibling for help.                                ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Around him, the lobby watches — older kids, younger kids, and bored bystanders — all witnessing  ║
║     the spectacle of a wannabe villain who can’t keep his story straight. One day he’s a hacker,     ║
║     the next he’s a “COM operator,” and by the weekend he’s claiming he’s part of some elite group   ║
║     that definitely doesn’t recruit people who still argue with their parents about chores.          ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     What defines Suppyss isn’t fear or power — it’s the shared understanding that he’s a child       ║
║     playing pretend in a world far larger than the fantasy he built for himself. His threats are     ║
║     foam swords, his ego is helium, and his entire act collapses the moment someone asks him to      ║
║     explain a single line of code.                                                                   ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     And through it all, Suppyss marches on, oblivious, overconfident, and unaware that the only      ║
║     person convinced by his performance is the one staring back at him in the VR mirror.             ║
║                                                                                                      ║
║     Welcome to the downfall.                                                                         ║
